description:
Burnout Recovery | Vagus Nerve Reset with Surbahar | 1 Hour

If your body keeps scanning for the next thing — your shoulders won't drop, your jaw won't unclench, your mind won't stop — you're not weak. You're stuck in sympathetic overdrive. This is a slow, deep recovery session built around the Surbahar and Raga Darbari Kanada, the raga Indian classical tradition has used for centuries to bring an exhausted nervous system back home.

The deep, sustained notes of the Surbahar — deep bass-sitar, low and sustained — coax the vagus nerve into a parasympathetic state. Layered with 432Hz tuning and a subtle 6Hz Theta carrier, this hour is designed to lower cortisol the way the body actually wants to do it: slowly, without forcing.

🌿 What you'll hear:
• Surbahar solo in Raga Darbari Kanada (deep evening healing raga)
• Tanpura drone background (steady tonal anchor)
• 432Hz tuning · 6Hz Theta wave entrainment

🌿 Chapters:
00:00 — Settle in (alap)
15:00 — Deepen (slow vistar)
30:00 — Hold the rest (sustained passages)
45:00 — Return softly

🌿 How to use:
Eyes closed, headphones, quiet room. Don't try to relax — let the Surbahar do the work.

🌿 Best for:
Overworked weeks · post-deadline crash · weekend recovery · before deep sleep · cortisol-spike mornings · adrenal fatigue

If this brought your shoulders down even one inch — subscribe. We're building a quiet corner of YouTube for the depleted.
